select history.id, history.code, history.start_time, history.end_time, history.site_code, history.site_name, history.mat_code, history.mat_name, history.factory_code , history.create_time, history.update_time, history.create_by, history.update_by, history.del_flag , container.type_code as typeCode, container.warehouse_code as warehouseCode, container.warehouse_name as warehouseName from wms_container_use_history history left join wms_container_barcode container on history.code = container.code where history.del_flag = '0'
and history.code like concat('%', #{params.code}, '%')
and history.warehosue_code like concat('%', #{params.warehouseCode}, '%')
and history.site_code like concat('%', #{params.siteCode}, '%')
and history.mat_code like concat('%', #{params.matCode}, '%')
and history.start_time <= #{params.startTime} and history.end_time >= #{params.startTime}
order by history.create_time desc
